reason_for_amendment: Bind accepted C02C and the frozen C03 v1 public interface; specify exact vector selection, arm construction, seed mapping, and receipt rules before production behavior or authoritative execution.

vector_space.definition: Every non-negative integer vector whose six counts sum exactly to bench_slots.
vector_space.tie_break: highest score, then lexicographically smallest counts in QB,RB,WR,TE,K,DST order

selection_score.name: whole_portfolio_v1
selection_score.units: dimensionless preregistered selection score; never a season-outcome claim
selection_score.formula: coverage + scarcity + fragility + contingency + replacement - correlation - specialist
selection_score.coverage: 0.55 times maximum bipartite matching of bench bodies to representative simultaneous QB,RB,WR,TE,FLEX and format-specific SUPERFLEX/QB2 holes
selection_score.scarcity: sum over each body depth d: (starter_need[position]*2.2 + replaceability[position]*league_scarcity)/d
selection_score.format_adjustments: superflex QB +0.9; 2QB QB +1.15; FLEX RB +0.35, WR +0.40, TE +0.10; TE adds 0.9*te_premium
selection_score.format_replaceability: multi-QB adds 1.15 to QB; TE adds 0.8*te_premium
selection_score.fragility: skill/QB marginal multiplied by 1.18 in no-IR and otherwise 1.0; IR adds 0.12/d stash value
selection_score.specialist: no hard K/DST cap; their low starter need and replaceability create soft opportunity cost

soft_marginal_costs: For each position and depth 0..bench_slots, cost is max(0, selected_score - best score among exact-budget vectors constrained to that position count), rounded to 6 decimals; all entries finite and soft.

arms.control: accepted C02C legacy e6 independent bounds preset and K/DST timing resolved from the accepted schema-v1 fixture
arms.candidate: exact selected complete vector: demand and ceiling both equal the selected count vector; K/DST timing remains the accepted control timing so only whole-bench composition changes

adapter.design: Two mirrored mixed-policy leagues per arm comparison; parity swaps control/candidate across alternating seats; same player pool, row, draft seed, season seed, and C02C EvalConfig in both runs.
adapter.season_seed_mapping: EvalConfig.seed = season_seed; because evaluate_season also drafts, adapter drafts explicitly with board_seed then calls public evaluate_rosters with EvalConfig.seed=season_seed
adapter.pairing_unit: season_seed x board_seed x season x seat

evidence_status_rule.measured: authoritative row executed with all preregistered pairs and deterministic/budget/legality gates pass
evidence_status_rule.interpolated: non-mandatory key resolves from nearest measured mandatory keys using deterministic normalized feature distance; never carries n_pairs or seeds
evidence_status_rule.unsupported: blocked key, incomplete execution, deterministic failure, malformed evidence, or extrapolation without support
evidence_status_rule.blocked_slice: t14-2qb-std-te0.5-b4-ir1 remains unsupported unless its own held-out and aggregate thresholds all clear

receipts.runtime: wall seconds and ru_maxrss MiB for selection, evaluator, generation, and total
receipts.immutability: Results and source receipts are write-once. Any rerun uses v2 filenames.

execution_rule: Commit this v2 manifest alone before editing production behavior. Run the authoritative experiment once only after deterministic implementation gates pass.
